intent: Complete portfolio domain evidence matrix, send through Pen/Bridge, get receipt, and close once downstream checks attach evidence.

source_context.current_status: PARTIAL evidence only; not lockable yet

known_drive_evidence.title: Domain Storage Usage Nameservers Health Last Change
known_drive_evidence.coverage: Migadu/domain control snapshot plus pasted DNS/SES audit narrative

known_drive_evidence.title: Completed COAX Bookmark Audit Register
known_drive_evidence.coverage: Bookmark/URL audit register; classification-first; runtime URL validation not performed

required_output.primary_artifact: single portfolio domain operating lock sheet
required_output.one_row_per: domain/surface/project touchpoint, with canonical roll-up fields
required_output.sort_order: top-down portfolio: umbrella, core, platform, commercial, mission, ventures, media, parked, retire-review
required_output.lock_gate: No row becomes LOCKED until evidence columns are checked and approval state is set.

evidence_checks_required.name: Drive source check
evidence_checks_required.description: Find and attach source sheets/docs that mention domain inventory, URL inventory, Vercel/GitHub/Lovable exports, business registry, product/pricing/assets.

evidence_checks_required.name: Route53/DNS check
evidence_checks_required.description: Export hosted zones and record sets where available; run public DNS checks for canonical domains and variants.

evidence_checks_required.name: Vercel check
evidence_checks_required.description: Export projects/domains/deployments and map to domain rows.

evidence_checks_required.name: GitHub check
evidence_checks_required.description: List repos under TML-4PM and map source repos to domains/surfaces where names or deployment config match.

evidence_checks_required.name: Lovable check
evidence_checks_required.description: Export Lovable projects/sites and map public surfaces to domain rows.

evidence_checks_required.name: Runtime check
evidence_checks_required.description: HTTP status, redirects, title/description capture, screenshot or response proof, broken-link flag.

evidence_checks_required.name: Email check
evidence_checks_required.description: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, SES identity status, Migadu mailbox/alias posture where accessible.

evidence_checks_required.name: GTM check
evidence_checks_required.description: Offer, CTA, pricing, lead capture, follow-up, campaign assets, analytics.

execution_rules: Do not delete or retire anything automatically.
Archive is allowed only as a recommendation unless approval is attached.
Anything on the final lock sheet is subject to approval workflow before changes.
Use REAL evidence where runtime/source checks are available; otherwise mark PARTIAL; reject PRETEND.
Return a receipt file under receipts/runtime/ with counts by status and evidence level.
